# llm-output-quality-monitor-api
Cloudflare Workers MCP server: llm-output-quality-monitor. REST + MCP (JSON-RPC 2.0). Live: api.lazy-mac.com/llm-output-quality-monitor

toolsPreview.name: quality_validator
toolsPreview.description: Validate LLM response quality based on length, format, and structure

toolsPreview.name: drift_detector
toolsPreview.description: Detect quality drift between current and previous LLM responses

toolsPreview.name: hallucination_scorer
toolsPreview.description: Pattern-based heuristic risk scoring for LLM responses (0-100). Detects linguistic signals such as contradictory assertions, unsourced claims, and uncertainty markers. Not a semantic hallucination detector.

toolsPreview.name: consistency_check
toolsPreview.description: Check consistency across multiple LLM responses
